cases.description: Divide two nonzero numbers returns the quotient
cases.input_strategy: parametrize representative nonzero divisor pairs, e.g. (10, 2) -> 5.0
cases.expected_behavior: Returns a / b as a float quotient

cases.description: Zero divisor raises ValueError with message
cases.input_strategy: call divide with b=0 (and negative/positive a to confirm it's the divisor check)
cases.expected_behavior: Raises ValueError with message 'divisor must not be zero'
cases.setup: Import divide from calculator; use pytest.raises(ValueError, match=...)

cases.description: Clamp returns lower bound when value is below range
cases.input_strategy: call clamp with value strictly less than lower, e.g. clamp(0.0, 1.0, 5.0)

cases.description: Clamp returns upper bound when value is above range
cases.input_strategy: call clamp with value strictly greater than upper, e.g. clamp(10.0, 1.0, 5.0)

cases.description: Clamp returns value unchanged when within range
cases.input_strategy: call clamp with value strictly between lower and upper, e.g. clamp(3.0, 1.0, 5.0)

cases.description: Clamp treats lower and upper bounds as inclusive
cases.input_strategy: parametrize value == lower and value == upper with valid bounds, e.g. clamp(1.0,1.0,5.0) and clamp(5.0,1.0,5.0)
cases.expected_behavior: Returns value unchanged at both inclusive bounds

cases.input_strategy: call clamp with lower > upper, e.g. clamp(2.0, 5.0, 1.0)
cases.expected_behavior: Raises ValueError with message 'lower exceeds upper'
cases.setup: Import clamp from calculator; use pytest.raises(ValueError, match=...)

cases.description: Equal bounds form a valid single-point range
cases.input_strategy: call clamp with lower == upper and value different from that bound, e.g. clamp(3.0, 5.0, 5.0)
cases.expected_behavior: Does not raise; returns the shared bound (5.0) since value is below lower
